title: Proof of Emergence of the gauge group
html:
Proof. Proof of Emergence of the gauge group

Proof. The argument proceeds in two steps, combined to identify G.

By (volume determinant), the volume constraint \epsilon \colon \Lambda^2 V \to \mathbf{1} together with naturality of g \in G forces \det(g_V) = 1, restricting the natural automorphisms from \mathrm{GL}(2) to \mathrm{SL}(2).

By (dagger unitarity), the non-degenerate Frobenius form \int_A induces a positive-definite dagger structure preserved by every g \in G, giving G \subseteq \mathrm{U}(2).

Combining both constraints:

  G =  \mathrm{SL}(2) \cap \mathrm{U}(2)
  =  \mathrm{SU}(2).

The volume constraint provides the special-linear condition (\det = 1); the positive-definite dagger structure provides the compactness (unitarity). \square
